title: pulicaria cylindrica
intro: Pulicaria cylindrica, commonly known as Jerusalem Pulicaria, is a medicinal plant that belongs to the Asteraceae family. It is traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fever, cough, and respiratory problems, due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antiviral properties. The therapeutic actions of Pulicaria cylindrica include reducing inflammation, fighting infections, and relieving cough and fever. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
